newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wong's Kong King says in cash call plan.
newsitem.headline: Wong's Kong King says in cash call plan.

text.p: Wong's Kong King International (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it was considering a fund raising exercise but gave no further details.
The company said it was "currently considering the possibility of undertaking a fund raising exercise."
"If this proposal is concluded, a further announcement will be made when appropriate," it added. The company also advises shareholers to exercise caution in dealing in its shares.
The company shares eased HK$0.015 to HK$0.38 in early trade.
Wong's Kong King trades chemicals and equipment used in the manufacture of electronic products.-HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
